descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S18 Handoff AI fails for some patients, both contexts: everyone still listed, the fallback card puts tasks in the right place and shows no placeholders, a clear message, never stuck

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 Handoff AI calls follow 3.5/3.9: timings are targets with 30 s as the upper limit for investigation; each call logs the AI provider's own time separately from the total and which model answered; … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U7 Sections populate only from stored data: an empty section stays empty (no discharge barrier invented when no discharge task exists, no invented pending result), and nothing in the handoff is invented … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U1 From the home screen, one tap on 'Handoff' generates summaries for the physician's patients in one action, not one patient at a time. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U2 Each patient's handoff has four sections: active issues, discharge barriers, pending results, to-do/if-then. (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U8 No email client opens, no mailto: link fires, and there is no email or external-share path for a handoff under any condition, failures included (the After-Pilot no-PHI email notification is absent to … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital: the S01 census plus H4 with no age and no diagnosis; the runs for H3 and H4 are forced to fail. Nursing Home: S02's N1–N3; N2's run is forced to fail

When Tap Handoff and wait until generation ends; save the sheet; tap Copy Text (the runner reads the clipboard); the same in Nursing Home

Then All patients are on the sheet; a clear message says summaries could not be generated, with Retry; Send is enabled, not stuck; each failed card lists every open task exactly once, never puts H3's discharge task under Pending Results, keeps the if-then line under To-Do and the important point under Active Issues; no '?yo' or 'undefined'; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. Sheet checkpoints: every name, the count, 'be generated' and 'Retry' (the banner), an enabled Send; no 'Generating', 'undefined', '?yo', '?y ·', disabled Send, 'mailto:', 'Email', 'Share'. Clipboard checkpoints, per failed card: each open task verbatim exactly once, the section rules above. …

Where it ran: dev; test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
